sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(trim(coalesce(generic, ''))) RLIKE '^(?:[0-9.,]+ ?%?[^a-z0-9-]+)?(?:(?:sodium|disodium|potassium|dipotassium|calcium|magnesium|hydrochloride|dihydrochloride|hcl|hydrobromide|sulfate|sulphate|phosphate|acetate|citrate|chloride|bromide|besylate|mesylate|maleate|tartrate|bitartrate|succinate|fumarate|gluconate|lactate|tromethamine|bicarbonate|carbonate|nitrate|hyclate|propionate|dipropionate|valerate|acetonide|pamoate|decanoate|meglumine|lysine|anhydrous|monohydrate|dihydrate|trihydrate|hexahydrate|base|free) +)*valine(?:-[a-z]{4})?(?:[^a-z0-9-]+(?:sodium|disodium|potassium|dipotassium|calcium|magnesium|hydrochloride|dihydrochloride|hcl|hydrobromide|sulfate|sulphate|phosphate|acetate|citrate|chloride|bromide|besylate|mesylate|maleate|tartrate|bitartrate|succinate|fumarate|gluconate|lactate|tromethamine|bicarbonate|carbonate|nitrate|hyclate|propionate|dipropionate|valerate|acetonide|pamoate|decanoate|meglumine|lysine|anhydrous|monohydrate|dihydrate|trihydrate|hexahydrate|base|free))*(?:$|[^a-z0-9-].*)' OR lower(generic) IN (SELECT lower(generic_name) FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE package_ndc IN ('0338-0499-06')) ORDER BY first_posting

rows.reasons: Delay in shipping of the drug|Demand increase for the drug|Other|Shortage of an active ingredient|Shortage of an inactive ingredient component
